import MeasureTheory.integrable
import MeasureTheory.ae_measurable
import MeasureTheory.measure

open MeasureTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {a b t : ℝ} (hm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hb : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
  have h_bounded : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤ Real.exp (t * b) := by
    rw [ae_eq]
    refine ⟨hb, fun ω => Real.exp_monotone (t * X ω) (t * b)⟩
  have h_ae_bounded : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Real.exp (t * X ω) ∈ Set.Ioc 0 Real.exp (t * b) := by
    rw [ae_eq]
    refine ⟨hb, fun ω => ⟨Real.exp_nonneg (t * X ω), Real.exp_monotone (t * X ω) (t * b)⟩⟩
  have h_strongly_measurable : StronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) := by
    rw [strongly_measurable]
    exact ae_measurable.fun_comp hm (fun x => Real.exp (t * x))
  apply integrable_of_ae_bounded h_strongly_measurable h_ae_bounded
